name: Karnataka PWD Schedule of Rates 2023-24 — Vol 1 (Common) + Vol 2 (Buildings)
department: Public Works, Ports & Inland Water Transport Department, Government of Karnataka
source_ref: KPWD Common Schedule of Rates 2023-24, Volume 2 Buildings (Grand Finale, 15-11-2023) — https://kpwd.karnataka.gov.in/storage/pdf-files/PWDSR-Vol-IIBuildings-GrandFinale-15-11-2023.pdf ; Vol 1 Common SR: https://kpwd.karnataka.gov.in/storage/pdf-files/Vol-1CommonSR-2023-24(GrandFinale)-15-11-2023.pdf
notes: Latest full Buildings volume published by KPWD. KPWD revises material prices through quarterly Issue Rates (2026-27 Q1 w.e.f. 04.04.2026 and Q2 w.e.f. 04.07.2026 are published on kpwd.karnataka.gov.in); those files are scanned images and are NOT applied here, so item rates are as printed in the 2023-24 volume. Vol 1 item codes are prefixed 'V1-'.
